findings.suggestion: Add a clear, complete description of the work, material, dimensions and applicable standards.

findings.title: Missing description and placeholder text
findings.message: Langtext consists only of "@@" and no Kurztext, leaving the 1 St position undefined, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Provide a complete specification of the work, materials and applicable norms.

findings.title: Missing separate charge for pipe fittings (Paßstücke)
findings.message: The note states that pipe fittings are included in the unit prices, but VOB/C § 4.2 requires separate listing of special services such as fittings when they are not covered by the base price.
findings.suggestion: Create a distinct position for pipe fittings or explicitly state that they are covered and reference the applicable standard (e.g. DIN 18331).

findings.title: Potential risk shift through vague clause
findings.message: The statement "Paßstücke sind in den Einheitspreisen der Rohrleitungspositionen enthalten" may shift the risk of additional fitting work to the contractor without clear compensation, which can be ineffective under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Clarify the extent of the inclusion and provide a fallback price for extra fittings.
